summary: Regression pass for English-only rollback (DoogieChat lang pinning, useFormLang pinned, SUPPORTED_LANGS=['en'], meta citation fix). Ran backend pytest (3 tests, 2 passed, 1 skipped due to live Turnstile) and 8 frontend regression checks via Playwright. All critical rollback assertions passed: no doogie-lang-select element, backend forces lang='en' even when 'fr' requested, MLS natural-language search returns results with features=['suite'], all lead forms (/buyer?lang=fa, /seller?lang=zh-Hant, /contact?lang=fa) render English LTR, no non-English hreflang on home, glossary ADU page at 390px has NO horizontal overflow (scrollWidth==clientWidth==390) and still has 5 [itemprop=citation] elements, /communities and /glossary load cleanly. Doogie MLS search correctly routed the 'townhouses in Langley with a suite' message to the MLS search path and returned listings cards.

issues: Non-blocking React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — appears in a <select>'s <option> somewhere in the tree, likely rendering an icon/span inside an <option>. Not caused by this rollback (predates it), but should be cleaned up to avoid hydration mismatches.

action_items: (Low priority) Fix the stray <span> inside an <option> tag causing React hydration warning in console on multiple pages.
No functional action items — English-only rollback is clean; no regressions detected.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is >10,000 lines — refactor into feature modules (DoogieChat, LeadForms, Routes) is overdue but out of scope for this rollback.

Backend lead-form test cannot be run end-to-end from pytest because Cloudflare Turnstile is enforced in preview env; recommend adding a TEST-ENV bypass header or Cloudflare test secret for automated regression.
context_for_next_testing_agent: English-only rollback verified. Key invariants to keep checking: (1) Doogie panel must NEVER expose data-testid='doogie-lang-select'. (2) POST /api/doogie/chat must ignore client body.language and reply in English. (3) /buyer, /seller, /referral-request, /contact must render English even when ?lang=fa/zh-Hant/pa/fr is in the URL and must stay dir='ltr'. (4) /glossary/accessory-dwelling-unit-adu at 390px must have scrollWidth==clientWidth==390 and 5 [itemprop=citation] elements (AiCitationFooter uses <meta itemProp='citation'> now). Buyer form end-to-end submit must be verified via UI (Turnstile) rather than raw API.
